connect.title: Connect your ticket

confirm.question: Connect {holderName}'s ticket for {eventName} to your account ({accountEmail})?
confirm.notYou: Not {holderName}? Don't connect, send the link to the right person.
confirm.failed: We couldn't connect your ticket. Try again.

connected.title: You're connected!
connected.body: Your bus, room and updates will show in the BISO app.

signedOut.body: Sign in with your BI account to connect your ticket.

connect.signInFailed: We couldn't start the BI sign-in. Try again in a moment.

needsBi.body: You're signed in with an account that isn't your BI account. Sign in with your BI account to connect your ticket.

linkedToOther.title: This ticket is already connected to another account.

accountHasTicket.title: Your account already has a ticket for {eventName}.
accountHasTicket.body: If this ticket belongs to someone else, send the link to them.

invalid.title: This link doesn't work anymore.
invalid.body: We can send a new link to the email address on your ticket.

help.title: Didn't get the email?
help.lede: Type the email address you used when you bought your ticket, and we'll send your link there.
help.sent: If that address is on a list, we've sent a link. Check your inbox and spam folder.
